Entities with an outstanding memo

entitywhy it is written before it is drawn
TATAKAA woman turned monstrous. How she is shown decides what the series says about women and monstrousness. Written before drawn.
RAVANATen heads are a design problem and a theological one. Not a costume.
SURPANAKHAThe mutilation scene. The memo settles what is shown and what is not, before any line is drawn.
MANTHARADeformity has been used as moral signal for a century of illustration. We will not.
AHALYAThe curse and the stone. Consent is at issue in the passage and in every retelling.
SITAThe largest design decision in the project. Not taken in passing.
VANARASThe line between person and animal. Every choice here is read racially whether we intend it or not.
LANKAGold city. Every prior depiction imports an orientalism we have to decide about first.
ASTRASWeapons that are also persons. A VFX answer would be the wrong answer.
FIGURE-FROM-THE-FIREThe being that rises from the sacrificial fire in Bala. Its form is not settled in the text.
